# GitHub panel for DeepSeek Harness
Manage the GitHub account that is already signed in on your PC — from inside DeepSeek Harness. The p
anel runs the GitHub CLI (`gh`) for you and shows the result on one page. **No token to paste, no AP
I key, no extra sign-in.**
*Illustrated preview with example data — not a live account.*
## What you get
- **Your connection, at a glance** — connected as `@you`, via the GitHub CLI, with the token scopes

GitHub reports.
- **Your repositories, counted** — total, public, private, archived, descriptions an

d topics coverage.
- **A "needs attention" list** — missing descriptions or topics, empty repositori

es, forks you no longer use, profile README, empty bio, unused pins, duplicate gists.
- **A searchab
le repository list** — edit a description or topics inline, archive or unarchive, rename, or open a

repository on GitHub.
- **Profile & pins** — what the GitHub API can and cannot change, with links t

o the right GitHub settings pages.
- **A health report** — README, license, `.gitignore`, CI, tests
and possible-secret checks per repository, with safe fixes you can apply in one click.

Restart `dsh web` afterwards. Replace `web` with your profile name if you use a custom one.
> Using the DeepSeek Harness desktop app? Use Option 1. The desktop app manages its own profile, so
a CLI install into `profiles/web` will not show up there.
### Option 3 — dsh-market
The plugin is submitted to the community **dsh-market** catalog. Once it appears there, you can sear
ch for **GitHub panel** and install it with one click.

## Before you start
| Requirement | Check |
| DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1 or newer** (tested on `0.2.1-rc.5`) | `dsh --version` or the About dialog

|
| GitHub CLI installed | `gh --version` — install from cli.github.com |
| Signed in to GitHub thr
ough the CLI | `gh auth status` |
If `gh` is not installed or not signed in, the panel tells you what to do instead of failing silentl
`gh` is not installed or not signed in, the panel tells you what to do instead of failing silently.
## First run

1. Click the **GitHub** icon in the left rail (next to *Plugins* and *Automation tasks*).
2. The pan

el shows **Connected as @you** and your repository counts.
3. If it says the account is not connecte

d: run `gh auth login` in a terminal, then press **Re-check**.
4. Use the filters above the reposito
ry list to narrow down what you want to fix, and the **Needs attention** list to start.
## Safety and privacy

- The panel is served by your own Harness process on `127.0.0.1` only.
- Every change re-reads the r
epository from GitHub first and needs admin rights on it; descriptions and topics are validated agai

n before writing.
- The panel **never reads the token**. It only launches `gh`, which holds the logi

n in your OS keyring.
- Nothing is written to disk by the panel; the action log is in memory and dis

appears when the Harness restarts.
- Repository deletion is not offered. Pins and profile name/bio a
re linked out to GitHub because the API has no write access for them.
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Fix |
| The **GitHub** icon is missing | Confirm the bundle is enabled on the Plugins page, reload the win

dow, and check that your DSH is 0.2.1 or newer. |
| "Not connected on this PC" | Run `gh auth login`

, confirm with `gh auth status`, then press **Re-check**. |
| The panel shows the wrong account | Ru

n `gh auth switch` (or `gh auth login` for the right account), then press **Re-check**. |
| "Loading
your GitHub account..." never finishes | Check the network (GitHub API reachability) and that `gh a

pi user` works in a terminal. |
| `gh` is not found in a sandboxed host | Set `DSH_GITHUB_CONFIG_DIR
` to the directory holding the `gh` config, or make sure `gh` on `PATH` belongs to the user running

the Harness. |
| A change fails with "permission" | The token needs the `repo` scope and you need ad
min rights on that repository. |
## Compatibility

- **DeepSeek Harness:** 0.2.1 or newer; developed and tested against `0.2.1-rc.5`.
- **Platforms:**

Windows 10/11 tested. macOS and Linux use `gh` from `PATH` and are untested.
- **GitHub CLI:** 2.x;

d. macOS and Linux use `gh` from `PATH` and are untested.
- **GitHub CLI:** 2.x; tested with 2.95.0.
## Development
There is no build step: the bundle is plain ESM JavaScript.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The preview image is generated, not captured: `python tools/make-preview.py` redraws it from code (r
equires Pillow). It contains example data only and carries an "Illustration with example data" note.
Clone the repo, link it into a DSH profile as shown under *Manual profile setup*, and reload. Change
s to `client.js` need a window reload; changes to `index.js` need the plugin to be re-enabled.
## Maintenance
Shared as-is. This project is not actively maintained: issues are not triaged and no response time i
s. This project is not actively maintained: issues are not triaged and no response time is promised.
If something breaks or you need a change, point your AI agent at this repository and have it diagnos

e and
patch your own copy or fork. Upstream pull requests may sit unreviewed.
